title: Listening party: Abbey Road | 1969
content:
A listening party for The Beatles’ Abbey Road album was held on 18 September 1969.

The event took place not at EMI Studios on Abbey Road, but at the band’s Apple Corps headquarters at 3 Savile Row, London.

The four of us would be greatly honoured if you would grace the first floor at APPLE 3, Savile Row, with your presence at 3:45 p.m. on September 18th so that we can meet you all again and play you our new album Abbey Road.
Listening party invitation
